question: What functional unit does the life-cycle assessment use, and in what software and with what primary impact assessment method were impacts calculated?
expect: treatment of 1 t of spent FCC catalyst; SimaPro 10.1 with Environmental Footprint (EF) 3.1 (adapted) (abstract; sec. 2)
trap: ReCiPe 2016 (used only for a supplementary comparison)
rendered: The life-cycle assessment uses the functional unit of "treatment of 1 t (1000 kg) of spent FCC catalyst."

prompt.system: You answer questions about one document, "Environmental and Preliminary Economic Assessment of Integrated Resource Recovery from Spent Fluid Catalytic Cracking Catalysts", using only what that document contains.
